name: CALEDONIA FARMERS MARKET - MARION FAMILY YMCA MARION, OH
tagline: Caledonia Farmers Market at the Marion Family YMCA
description: CALEDONIA FARMERS MARKET - MARION FAMILY YMCA MARION, OH is a farmers market in 645 Barks Rd E, OH, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
